content.text:
{
  "hazard_consequence_node": [
    {
      "label": "HazardConsequence",
      "name": "Pool fire",
      "node_id": "H1",
      "node_type": "HazardConsequence",
      "evidence": "The incident description repeatedly identifies the event as a pool fire: the Pearland Fire Chief 'observed a ground level pool fire, 65 to 80 feet in width' east of warehouse 1. CSB states that 'the initial small fire involving the smaller containers resulted in a pool fire,' and that ruptured drums, failed blend tanks, and the failed tank wagon added fuel so that burning liquid 'flowed toward the storage tanks and the warehouses.' Section 2.3.4 further describes a 'Liquid Pool Fire at Tank Farm and Warehouses' and explains that inadequate drainage/containment allowed released burning liquids to spread through the facility.",
      "explanation": "The central accident mechanism analyzed in the report is the formation and spread of burning liquid pools from released combustible/flammable liquids. The report focuses on how a small initial fire escalated because drums ruptured, tanks failed, and inadequate containment and drainage allowed the burning liquid pool to spread into the tank farm and warehouses. This makes pool fire the primary hazard consequence.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "entity_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Material",
      "name": "combustible liquids",
      "node_id": "En1",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "Approximately 10 drums of combustible liquid were located on and around packaging line 4",
      "explanation": "Combustible liquid products stored in drums and other containers near packaging line 4 were a principal fuel source for the spreading pool fire.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Location",
      "name": "packaging line 4, outside warehouse 1",
      "node_id": "En2",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "The guard stated that the fire appeared to be located outdoors on a worktable at packaging line 4",
      "explanation": "This was the initial observed fire location and the area where combustible-liquid drums and the nearby tank wagon became involved.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Location",
      "name": "storage tank area",
      "node_id": "En3",
      "node_type": "Entity",
      "evidence": "As the fire spread into the storage tank area",
      "explanation": "The pool fire later propagated into the tank farm/storage tank area after released burning liquids breached inadequate containment.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "condition_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "Phase",
      "name": "Liquid",
      "node_id": "C1",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "the liquid pool fire was also observed to be moving from the warehouse 1 area toward the front of the facility",
      "explanation": "The hazardous material was burning as pooled liquid on the ground.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Pressure",
      "name": "High pressure",
      "node_id": "C2",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "these drums ruptured due to internal pressure and released their contents",
      "explanation": "Closed containers were heated by fire, building internal pressure before rupture and release.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Temperature",
      "name": "High temperature",
      "node_id": "C3",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "it was already being heated to a significant temperature",
      "explanation": "Fire exposure raised equipment and liquid temperature enough to cause venting and structural failure.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Volatility",
      "name": "Low volatility",
      "node_id": "C4",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "synthetic motor oil (flash point > 400ºF)",
      "explanation": "The dominant fuel inventory included heavy oil products with high flash point, indicating relatively low volatility.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Combustibility",
      "name": "Combustible",
      "node_id": "C5",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "containing a combustible liquid synthetic motor oil",
      "explanation": "The released material was capable of burning and sustaining the pool fire.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "ReleaseType",
      "name": "Instant release",
      "node_id": "C6",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "these drums ruptured due to internal pressure and released their contents",
      "explanation": "The drum failures caused sudden loss of liquid contents that rapidly enlarged the burning pool.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Confinement",
      "name": "Low confinement",
      "node_id": "C7",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "it is most likely that the fire started outside, directly adjacent to warehouse 1",
      "explanation": "The initiating fire and early pool fire developed in an outdoor area with little enclosure.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "Dispersion",
      "name": "Not dispersed",
      "node_id": "C8",
      "node_type": "Condition",
      "evidence": "begin pooling around the storage tanks",
      "explanation": "Released material spread as ground-level liquid pools rather than as a dispersed vapor cloud.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ],
  "event_nodes": [
    {
      "label": "InitiatingEvent",
      "name": "Initial fire starts outside adjacent to warehouse 1",
      "node_id": "Ev1",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "it is most likely that the fire started outside, directly adjacent to warehouse 1",
      "explanation": "The earliest identified abnormal event was an outdoor fire near warehouse 1; the exact cause of that fire was not determined.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "MechanicalFailure",
      "name": "Rupture of drums of combustible liquid at packaging line 4",
      "node_id": "Ev2",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "these drums ruptured due to internal pressure and released their contents",
      "explanation": "Drum rupture was a direct loss-of-containment event that added fuel to the pool fire and accelerated fire spread.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    },
    {
      "label": "IgnitionSource",
      "name": "Unknown ignition source",
      "node_id": "Ev3",
      "node_type": "Event",
      "evidence": "was unable to identify which of the following was most likely",
      "explanation": "A fire clearly occurred, but the specific ignition source could not be determined from the incident investigation.",
      "source": "incident_description"
    }
  ]
}
